title: WEATHER FORECAST FOR 27 FEBRUARY 2026 Issued at 2.00 p.m. on 26 February 2026 Mainly fair weather will prevail over the most parts of the island. Showers or thundershowers are likely at a few places in Southern province and in Rathnapura and Monaragala districts after 2.00 p.m. Misty conditions can be expected at some places in Central, Sabaragamuwa, Western, North-western and North-central provinces and in Galle, Matara, Monaragala and Mannar districts during the early hours of the morning.
